dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: You might find this hard to imagine, but many people in this world would love a chance to restart their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: But a little change to one's appearance can halve the difficulty — and that's my specialty, see?

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: There's a bright future ahead for this sort of research, and you look like the sort of person with an eye on the future, so, would you consider sponsoring me?

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: I'm a proper engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute, you know? ... Well, I was, anyway.
